# IPv6 Test · 1ms.dog

> Free IPv6 test in the browser: is the visitor's network IPv6 ready? Six tests run from the visitor's own browser:
> an IPv4-only and an IPv6-only host (A and AAAA records only), a dual-stack host (which protocol the browser picks,
> and whether it waits for IPv6), large packets over IPv6 on a new connection (path MTU), and an IPv6 and an IPv4
> address with no DNS (IPv6 without DNS; IPv6-only networks with NAT64). Shows the IPv4 and IPv6 addresses (with
> ASN and country where the host reports them) and a score out of 10, after test-ipv6.com's idea: 4 points for
> IPv6-only sites, 2 for large packets, 2 for dual-stack sites without delay, 1 for IPv6 without DNS, 1 when the
> browser prefers IPv6, minus 1 when IPv6 is slow. Each test asks two to four providers at once (Cloudflare,
> Google, DNSPod, AliDNS, icanhazip, ipify), so one answers wherever the visitor is, and takes the first answer.
> Nothing is sent to this site.

- Page: https://ipv6.1ms.dog/ (also /zh-cn/, /zh-tw/, /ja/, /ko/, /es/, /fr/, /de/, /pt/, /ru/)
- IPv4 against IPv6: the same four networks (Cloudflare, Google, Akamai, DNSPod) asked over each at once, round trips
  compared; on its own (no score, no other test) as a page on slow IPv6, with why it happens and what to do:
  https://ipv6.1ms.dog/ipv6-slow/
- Comparison hosts: cf: 1.0.0.1 / [2606:4700:4700::1111]; gg: 8.8.8.8 / [2001:4860:4860::8888]; ak: ipv4.whatismyip.akamai.com / ipv6.whatismyip.akamai.com; dp: ipv4.ddnspod.com / ipv6.ddnspod.com
- Test hosts: v4: ipv4.ddnspod.com, ipv4.icanhazip.com, ipv4-check-perf.radar.cloudflare.com; v6: ipv6.ddnspod.com, ipv6.icanhazip.com, ipv6-check-perf.radar.cloudflare.com; ds: ipv6.1ms.dog, icanhazip.com, api64.ipify.org; big: [2606:4700:4700::1001], [2001:4860:4860::8844], api6.ipify.org; lit6: [2606:4700:4700::1111], [2606:4700:4700::64], [2001:4860:4860::6464]; lit4: 1.0.0.1, 8.8.4.4, 223.5.5.5
- Source code: https://github.com/yt1988/ipv6-test
